settings.asOf: Required local ISO date; dated observations through this date only.
settings.shippingCalendar: Explicit open weekdays array1..7 and closedDates[]; used only to subtract declared transit days from delivery deadlines.

notes: resource.open_weekdays explicit pipe-delimited ISO weekdays1..7. calendar rows override each resource/day capacity; zero closes it. No implicit five- or seven-day calendar.

All capacities and units_per_piece are maker-declared comparable integer reservation units. Every active stage day reserves whole batch input_qty × units_per_piece; this is declared occupancy, not throughput physics.

day_basis calendar|resource-open. Calendar durations count elapsed consecutive dates and reserve declared resource units on each occupied day; resource-open durations use open resource dates. Resource-closed collisions remain visible.
Yield is integer basis points1..10000. Backward required inputs use exact ceil; projected remaining yield uses exact floor and is separate from observed actual good.

due_basis ship|delivery|ready. transit_days canonical integer; ship and ready dates require0. Delivery subtracts only maker-declared shipping calendar days. Orders/batches always expose productionDue; ready has shipBy:null.

Stock allocated by order; blank order is unallocated. A stock row linked to a current batch must match that batch/product/order and is a subset of its final actual good, counted once via batch output. Independent ready stock reduces remaining demand.
Batch target_good quantities are explicit order allocations. Over/underallocation is attention. No invented batch splitting or capacity solver.

Observations are complete batch-stage snapshots, not additive movements. Distinct event IDs/timestamps retain corrections; latest eligible snapshot drives current progress. Counts conserve input=good+reject+held. complete requiresheld0. Real-date local_date supplied explicitly beside offset timestamp; no silent timezone conversion.

A current batch advances sequentially: downstream observations require upstream completed before their instant, and downstream input cannot exceed prior good. Completed batch-linked stock cannot be counted twice.
All original CSV text and observations retained by immutable edition. Decisions retain correction history bound to exact edition/asOf/target; a decision alone changes no quantities.

Plan asOf cannot precede edition.settings.asOf because ready stock is an undated snapshot. Retained downstream stage events require strictly earlier upstream completion. Active observations do not automatically count as unstarted-late.
Zero surviving flow keeps source-required dates/shortage visible but creates no resource reservation or compatibility group.
resources.daily_capacity may be zero. Positive dated calendar overrides then describe only confirmed shared-studio slots, without recurring availability.
